summary: Validated onboarding primary recovery focus personalization end-to-end across backend APIs and UI. Core requested flows pass: focus-first onboarding, multi-select behavior, exact stage options, onboarding->dashboard transition, focus-personalized first-visit dashboard/course/professor/learning-plan, AI chat stream continuity, and returning-user transition after first visit mark. One backend validation gap remains.

minor.issue: Backend accepts empty primary_recovery_focus list (200 OK). Requirement states primary focus should be required before continuing onboarding. UI enforces it, but API contract currently does not.

action_items: Enforce backend validation for onboarding primary_recovery_focus (non-empty, ideally validate values against PRIMARY_RECOVERY_FOCUS_OPTIONS).
Keep first-session transition timing in mind for UI assertions (dashboard mark-visited runs asynchronously after initial load).
critical_code_review_comments: OnboardingRequest uses primary_recovery_focus: List[str] = [] with no minimum length/value validation, creating API/UI contract mismatch.
server.py remains large (>700 lines) and concentrates cross-cutting onboarding/dashboard/AI logic, increasing regression risk.

success_rate.backend: 92% (13/13 targeted tests passed; 1 requirement-level validation gap identified via passing behavior)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all targeted onboarding/dashboard UI checks passed after accounting for mark-visited async timing)

test_credentials: Read and used /app/memory/test_credentials.md credentials for seeded-user regression verification.
seed_data_creation: Created new test users via /api/auth/register and UI registration for isolated onboarding personalization validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary-focus personalization is functioning in API and UI for Alcohol+Opioids path. Added reusable regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_onboarding_primary_focus_personalization.py. Remaining known gap is API-side required validation for empty primary_recovery_focus.
rca of the issue: RCA (validation gap): OnboardingRequest model defines primary_recovery_focus with default empty list and no Field(min_length=1), so /api/onboarding accepts [] despite product requirement that focus be required. Repro: register -> POST /api/onboarding with primary_recovery_focus: [] -> 200 with profile.primary_recovery_focus=[] returned.
